name: word-count-HotCRP
description: Live word count that matches HotCRP's word limits, for the document or the current selection(s), with a character counter you can turn on and off. Fork of ms-vscode.wordcount.

wordcount.showCharacterCount.description: Show the character count next to the word count in the status bar. Toggle it with the "Word Count: Toggle Character Count" command or by clicking the status bar item.

wordcount.languages.markdownDescription: Language IDs the word count is shown for. Use `*` to show it for every file.

enumDescriptions: Count words the way HotCRP does for submission word limits: a run of non-space text whose first character is not one of - . , ; : < > ! ? * _ ~ ` # |. Markdown markers are skipped; ©, emoji, parentheses and URLs count; a run of CJK text with no spaces is one word.
Words hold a letter or digit, so Markdown markers such as #, - and > are skipped. Each Chinese or Japanese character is one word.
Match online word counters that are given the raw text: as markdown, but symbols such as ©, ™ and emoji are words, and a URL is a word of its own, so a link [label](https://…) is two words.
Every run of non-space characters is a word, # and - included, as in the original ms-vscode.wordcount and wc -w.
wordcount.countMode.markdownDescription: How words are counted. The default `hotcrp` matches the word limits HotCRP applies to abstracts, reviews and comments. Use `markdown` for Markdown-aware counting, `online` to get the same number as a web-based word counter that you paste the raw text into, or `whitespace` for the original extension's numbers.
